summary:
We developed *ASTRAVORA FIELDLENS*, a satellite-data-driven agricultural decision-support platform focused on Virudhunagar district, Tamil Nadu. It addresses the challenge of transforming complex Earth observation data into practical, understandable crop-rotation recommendations for farmers.

The platform integrates NASA datasets, including GPM IMERG rainfall, SMAP soil moisture, Landsat NDVI, and NASA POWER meteorological data, along with TNAU and ICAR agricultural knowledge. It combines these observations with soil type, previous crop, irrigation availability, growing season, and farmer preferences through an explainable, rule-based Crop Rotation Engine.

The system generates three crop-rotation options: overall suitability, alternative recommendations, and low-water options, with explanations and supporting data.

This project is important because it helps farmers understand local environmental conditions, consider water availability, maintain soil health, and make more informed crop-rotation decisions. Our goal is to bridge the gap between satellite observations and practical agricultural decision-making.
details:
ASTRAVORA FIELDLENS is a satellite-data-driven agricultural decision-support platform designed for Virudhunagar district, Tamil Nadu.

Our platform collects and analyses real Earth observation data from NASA, including GPM IMERG rainfall, SMAP soil moisture, Landsat NDVI, and NASA POWER meteorological data. It also integrates TNAU and ICAR agricultural knowledge to understand regional soil conditions and farming requirements.

The Explainable Crop Rotation Engine considers soil type, pH, previous crops, irrigation facilities, growing season, water availability, and farmer preferences to generate three crop rotation options: overall suitability, alternative crops, and low-water options. Each recommendation includes explanations to help users understand the decision.

We developed an interactive web-based application using Google AI Studio, NASA Earth observation data services, GIS mapping, and OpenStreetMap-based visualization.

The creative aspect of our project is connecting multiple satellite datasets with agricultural knowledge to convert complex environmental observations into understandable farming recommendations.

Our main benefits are better-informed crop selection, efficient water management, improved soil health, and sustainable agriculture. Our intended impact is to help farmers make data-driven decisions and build climate-resilient farming practices.
